info.name: Invite Registration
info.description:
Invite Registration lets administrators create personal, cryptographically random invitation links. New Nextcloud user accounts can only be created by opening a valid invitation link — there is no public self-service registration button.
Features: - Admin-generated invitation links with configurable expiry and usage limits - One-time or multi-use links - Revoke links at any time - Email verification: accounts are activated only after the user confirms their email - Per-link group assignment: choose which group a new user joins - Automatic team folder: a Group Folder is created for the group if the Group Folders app is installed - Creates normal Nextcloud accounts (not guests) via the native user manager - Passwords are never stored by the app; they are passed straight to Nextcloud - No token enumeration: invalid, expired, revoked and exhausted links show a generic error
info.author: Invite Registration Contributors
